description: SQL-B, deciding variant: bracket the statement-length limit (64001 opened, 65535 gave 3035 earlier). Opens SELECT ID FROM One padded with trailing spaces to 64500, 65000 and 65534 UTF-16 units through OpenRecordset, and creates a temporary QueryDef of 65534 units. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-B; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
